can1357/oh-my-pi ↗ 2 releases · 2 stable
v18.15.0 Stable2026-11-01T14:17:08Z

@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Fixed

  • Fixed OpenAI remote compaction (/responses/compact) replaying backend-only internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough metadata that Codex rejects as an unknown parameter (#17590 by @briankeefe)

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Fixed

  • Fixed Codex conversation replay failing with an unknown internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough.content_token_count parameter by omitting backend-internal response metadata from replayed input (#17590, #17597 by @briankeefe).
  • Fixed service_tier: "ultrafast" being dropped for OpenAI-family models on custom providers even when the model's serviceTiers lists it (#17577 by @jakehemmerle)
  • Fixed Google Vertex requests with Workforce Identity Federation ADC failing token refresh against the wrong endpoint (#17447).
  • Fixed Anthropic (and other rotating-token) OAuth accounts being signed out automatically when a background usage poll's token refresh got invalid_grant, including refreshes a client delegates to an auth broker; usage polling no longer disables credentials, so only a real request's refresh can do that (#17468)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added

  • Added Modular Cloud (modular) as a provider: /login modular with an API key, models and prices from the models.dev modular entry, and per-model reasoning controls for MiniMax M3.1 Flash, MiniMax M3, and Gemma 4 31B (#17334 by @tommyjtl)
  • SambaNova Cloud follow-up turns now reuse the provider's prefix cache, so multi-turn conversations stop re-processing earlier context (#17555 by @rjuez00)

Fixed

  • Fixed newly discovered OpenAI-compatible models ignoring provider-reported context and output token limits (#17561 by @wolfiesch)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added

  • Long or multi-step background shell commands get a one-line caption saying what they do and when they end, written once per job by the widget model role when the job, after running 15 seconds, is shown in a live widget or listed by /jobs full; the jobs sheet and /jobs full show it under the job's purpose. It follows the Live Job Widgets setting (async.widgets), and CreateAgentSessionOptions.jobCaptionWriter replaces the model call (#17649 by @wolfiesch)

Changed

  • In a source checkout, the error for a missing HTML export viewer now names the script that builds it, packages/collab-web/scripts/build-export-viewer.ts, beside bun gen:export-viewer (#17636 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed an eval cell running silently on a new kernel after the session's Python kernel or JS worker died between cells (a crash, a kill, an out-of-memory kill, or a cancelled JS cell): the first cell on the replacement now carries Kernel restarted: … state is unavailable. Re-run needed setup ahead of its own output, instead of failing with a bare NameError on a variable an earlier cell set (#17595 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed a task worker messaged (write agent://<id>) while still starting up running on the shared context alone and never receiving its tasks[].task assignment; the message now waits for the assignment's turn (#17587)
  • lsp reload now discovers Rust crates created after rust-analyzer started, so hover and other analysis work without restarting omp (#17658).
  • A model without image input (GLM, DeepSeek, Grok Composer and the like) reads a snapcompact archive's full kept text instead of image-omitted placeholders for its frames, after a model switch, on resume and in side requests (#17510 by @will-bogusz)
  • Snapcompact no longer refuses a new archive as "would not reduce context" when it shrinks a session that already holds one (/compact snapcompact, idle and pre-prompt compaction) (#17490 by @will-bogusz)
  • A failed /compact snapcompact now reports its reason once instead of twice, and names the /compact mode to run instead (#17490 by @will-bogusz)
  • Background bash and eval jobs now carry the purpose the model gave for the call: /jobs, /jobs full, proc:// listings, wait and job results, and the jobs HUD hover lead with it ahead of the raw command line (#17649 by @wolfiesch)
  • The seance guidance in the task tool and the archive docs now say that a question about an earlier session is answered by the seance agent, and that reading the session's raw JSONL belongs to narrow mechanical checks only, so a consult is no longer duplicated by transcript reads and re-run checks (#17523 by @iacore)

Fixed

  • A prompt on a model whose provider has no usable credential (logged out, refresh token expired, or an auth broker holding none) now switches to the first retry.fallbackChains candidate that has one instead of failing with "No API key found", and switches back on the first prompt after the credential returns (#17559 by @wolfiesch)
  • Fixed background results arriving during manual /compact starting turns on stale history or disappearing from the saved session (#17599).
  • Fixed isolated tasks on fuse-overlayfs leaving their overlay mounted and the fuse-overlayfs daemon running when the unmount hit a transient "Device or resource busy"; a failed unmount now reports fusermount's error and keeps the workspace for omp worktree clear instead of deleting its layers under the live mount (#17644)
  • Usage-limit retries now count system sleep toward the quota-reset deadline instead of re-arming the remaining uptime delay after the countdown reaches zero (#17606 by @zhiland).
  • Fixed role assignments to a models.yml model whose id differs only by case from a bundled model of the same provider (such as xiaomi/MiMo-V2.6-Pro beside xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro) silently staying unset (#17580)
  • Fixed Eval's direct browser wait helpers (tab.waitForSelector, tab.waitForText, …) giving up after 29 s when passed a longer { timeout }; the requested timeout is now honored up to the browser tool's 300 s cap (#17617)
  • Fixed browser.open with a fresh custom Chrome profile failing when Chrome has no initial tabs; it now opens its own tab without navigating an existing one (#17583).
  • Fixed the read tool's repeated-output notice suggesting a path:A-B selector on xd:// topics, MCP resources and other URLs that reject selectors (#17631)
  • The lsp tool now starts typescript-native (tsc --lsp --stdio) for a TypeScript 7 tsc installed without a package.json, such as the nixpkgs package, instead of leaving the project with no TypeScript server (#17659)
  • DuckDuckGo excludes advertising click redirects before applying result limits, keeping them out of direct and Public Web sources (#17564 by @jasonharrison).
  • Fixed /fast refusing Ultrafast ("The current model does not offer the Ultrafast service tier") on custom OpenAI-compatible providers whose /v1/models row lists ultrafast in service_tiers, such as relays in front of a ChatGPT subscription (#17577 by @jakehemmerle)
  • Importing the SDK no longer takes over the embedding host's signal and fatal-error shutdown; registered cleanup still runs at exit (#17674).
  • Fixed raw browser page.waitForFunction waits timing out after a full-document navigation even when the destination matches the predicate (#17584)
  • Fixed a Ctrl+R history entry picked while an ask dialog's "Other" or note prompt is open landing in the hidden main chat input instead of that prompt (#17565)
  • Bash commands no longer hang on git rebase -i when git config sets a sequence.editor (an inline GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR=… still wins), or on Git Credential Manager GUI/browser sign-in prompts (#17452 by @wolfiesch)
  • Fixed intercepted bash commands asking for approval before being blocked anyway (#17502 by @asuffield)
  • Fixed omp --from-claude listing a Claude Code session renamed with /rename by its first prompt; the picker now shows the renamed title and importing the session keeps it (#17361 by @namest504).
  • Auto-learn capture turns now reuse the main turn's prompt cache instead of re-sending the whole conversation uncached: they advertise the same tool list and refuse every call except learn and manage_skill without running it (#17418 by @STRML).
  • Fixed extensions being unable to replace the background-job completion card with registerMessageRenderer("async-result", …); a registered renderer now owns the card, and the built-in row remains the fallback when none is registered, when one declines, and when one throws (#17372 by @AlexBrd999, from #14484 by @F0Rextasy; #14131)
  • Local dictation stops live previews when the speech model repeatedly cannot keep up, so final transcripts no longer wait behind repeated previews (#17410).
  • ACP clients now receive _omp/compaction/start and _omp/compaction/end notifications, including failures and cancellations, without requiring an active prompt. (#16969; #17384 by @SAKANA-MOONLIGHT).
  • Fixed cd (and pushd/popd/z) failing with command not found: __zsh_like_cd in agent shells when mise activate or zoxide init installed wrapper functions: the shell snapshot now keeps the underscore-prefixed helper functions those wrappers call, instead of dropping every private-looking function (#17448 by @KamijoToma)

@oh-my-pi/collab-web

Changed

  • job tool results name each background job by the purpose the model gave for it, falling back to its command (#17649 by @wolfiesch)

@oh-my-pi/pi-natives

Fixed

  • Fixed the bash tool's shell stopping with status 1 and no message after about 40 levels of nested functions, eval or source when the process may open only 1,024 files; a shell that runs out of open files now says so and names the limit to raise (#17668 by @sjawhar)
  • bun check now runs the Rust half when your branch commits a Rust change on a clean tree, skips it on a TypeScript-only branch even under CI=true, and prints one line saying which it did and why (OMP_FORCE_RUST_TASKS=1 always runs it) (#17628 by @sjawhar)

@oh-my-pi/snapcompact

Added

  • Added viewWithoutFrames: what a reader without image input reads for an archive, its kept text in place of its frames (#17510 by @will-bogusz)

@oh-my-pi/pi-tui

Breaking Changes

  • GroupedLineContext.isUrl is replaced by url, the internal URL a header names or a body row belongs to (#17608 by @JustasMasiulis)

Added

  • Added FILE_NAME_COLOR, formatStyledPath and pathNameStart to render/render-utils for paths in tool bodies and Tern file rows; createGroupedRowStyler, groupedLinkTargets, fitGroupsToBudget, groupsByFile and isMatchRow to tools/grouped-file-output; splitReadQuery to tools/read; and HASHLINE_TAG_SUFFIX_RE to tools/hashline-format. classifyGroupedLines reports each file header's full displayPath and suffix, and a TranscriptStatusPart without color keeps its already-styled text (#17608 by @JustasMasiulis)
  • JobsPanelJob.caption: the jobs sheet's detail pane shows it, muted, between the job's purpose and its command (omp.jobs.caption) (#17649 by @wolfiesch)

Changed

  • The Background jobs sheet names each job by what it is for when the model said so, shows that above the full command in the detail pane, and no longer repeats the command in an empty widget box for jobs that print nothing (#17649 by @wolfiesch)
  • File paths in tool output share one style: a dim directory and the file name in the custom-message label color (bronze in titanium), with line locations and selectors (:1-175, :42:14, ?q=) muted. This covers Grep, AST Grep, AST Edit, Glob, Find, LSP, diagnostics, grouped Reads and file mentions; Glob's folder icon is muted like the file-type icons, and paths in tool headers keep their color (#17608 by @JustasMasiulis)
  • Grep, AST Grep and AST Edit results label each file with its full path instead of the model-facing # dir/ and ## file#tag headers, and each file gets its own tree branch. Their collapsed previews fit the same row budget the same way, cutting the last file short rather than overflowing, and end with … N more matches (… N more files for AST Edit) (#17608 by @JustasMasiulis)
  • AST Grep match rows link to their line, as Grep's do (#17608 by @JustasMasiulis)
  • LSP diagnostics carry their severity color on the [error]/[warning] tag instead of the location, and collapsed diagnostic rows now show that tag (#17608 by @JustasMasiulis)

Fixed

  • Rex sessions now render Kitty graphics without forcing the protocol, including when only TERM=xterm-rex identifies the client (#17651).
  • Fixed collapsed AST Grep showing no matches when its first file or folder was taller than the preview, and its … N more row counting hidden folders instead of hidden matches (#17608 by @JustasMasiulis)
  • Fixed collapsed AST Edit overflowing its preview when the first file's diff was long (#17608 by @JustasMasiulis)
  • Fixed search and diagnostic file paths in Tern dropping the leading / of absolute paths and a folder's own (…) ending, and AST Edit diffs in Tern losing highlighting to the file's #tag; a file name ending in lowercase or other-length #… text keeps it (#17608 by @JustasMasiulis)
  • Fixed a read of a URL drawing as dead text in the folded read row: its target is not a file path, so no link was built for it, and clicking the URL did nothing. The row (and each row of a grouped read) now links to the URL itself, gaining an https:// scheme for a bare www. host (#17598 by @iacore)
  • Fixed replayed transcripts ignoring a registered async-result message renderer, so a replayed conversation rendered differently from the live one (#17372 by @AlexBrd999, from #14484 by @F0Rextasy; #14131)

@oh-my-pi/pi-utils

Added

  • Added abortable sleepUntil for wall-clock deadline waits that include system sleep, with bounded timer slices to recheck deadlines after resume (#17606 by @zhiland).

Fixed

  • Importing pi-utils no longer installs process-wide signal and fatal handlers in embedding hosts; exit-time cleanup stays installed (#17674).

v18.14.2 Stable2026-10-31T17:56:02Z

@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Added

  • The soft steering signal a tool sees as toolCall.steeringSignal now aborts with the source of the queued message ("user", "irc", …) as its reason, so a tool can yield only to the sources it should (#17537)

Fixed

  • Reject incomplete local compaction, turn-prefix, handoff, and branch summaries ending with stopReason: "length" instead of using truncated text as complete context. Omit incomplete display-only short summaries without discarding a completed full summary (#17499 by @Xytronix).

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Breaking Changes

  • Replaced isLoopGuardedModel with loopGuardLevel, which returns "off", "exact", or "semantic" from the model's thinking-loop-guard catalog rule

Added

  • Added disableServerSideFallback to FactoryDroidOptions and SimpleStreamOptions: a Factory Droid request leaves out the server-side refusal fallback chain and fails, before any of its content is streamed, if another model answers it (#12229 by @Xytronix)

Changed

  • DeepSeek and Grok models on Amazon Bedrock now get the same near-duplicate reasoning-loop checks as on other hosts

Fixed

  • Fixed Claude turns failing with "Thinking loop detected" when summarized thinking repeated a progress line such as "Still writing the parser..."; Claude models no longer run the loop guard
  • Fixed the loop guard discarding turns from other models whose reasoning summary repeats one status line a few times; whole-line repetition now has to cover about 1 KB before it counts as a loop
  • Fixed per-request OpenAI-compatible headers being combined with differently cased model headers instead of overriding them (#17513 by @jchanghong023)
  • Fixed a stalled Anthropic stream that keeps sending empty content deltas never timing out, because those deltas were treated as stream progress (#17484 by @jchanghong023)
  • Fixed Anthropic-compatible endpoints that put a thinking signature on the streamed content block losing it, so replayed reasoning keeps its signed block (#17483 by @jchanghong023)
  • Fixed AuthStorage.close() and replaceStore() losing a rotated OAuth refresh token when a refresh was still in flight, with or without durable refresh leases; the store now stays open until that token is saved, and new refreshes are refused (#17518)
  • Fixed /usage showing Cursor's "Other Models" meter as an inflated dollar amount; it now shows the percentage Cursor reports, like Cursor Models (#17462 by @eggpeat)
  • Fixed the omp auth-gateway Responses endpoint rejecting documented null values for temperature, top_p, output limits, reasoning, and reasoning summaries (#17466 by @Xytronix).
  • Fixed provider HTTP errors printing the response body twice when the thrown error already carried it, including responses with a retry header (#17503 by @metaphoric-dev)
  • Fixed Gemini tool calls through the omp auth-gateway chat-completions endpoint failing on the next turn: the gateway now returns each call's thought signature in extra_content and replays the one a client sends back (#17509 by @justdoGIT)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Breaking Changes

  • Removed thinkingLoopGuard from compat records; thinking-loop-guard is now a catalog axis that applies on every host, with "semantic" for Gemini, DeepSeek, and Grok and "off" for Claude

Fixed

  • Fixed GitHub Copilot Claude 5.x base models (claude-opus-5, claude-opus-5.5, claude-sonnet-5, claude-sonnet-5.5) reporting the 1M window of their -1m variants once the model list was read from cache; discovered limits now survive cached reads instead of reverting to bundled values (#17481)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added

  • Added task.perCallModel (off by default, eval, on) so a task item or an eval agent()/workpool() call can run on one exact model the operator already names: a chat role from your own (non-project) settings, the selected agent's own model, or the parent's current model. Glob values (anthropic/*) never approve a model. task.perCallModelAllow narrows that list, task.maxEffort caps the worker's effort, and the worker never switches to another model. Project settings can only narrow this: they never turn it on or approve a model (#12229 by @Xytronix)
  • Added Settings.reloadFromDisk({ includeParents: true }), which reloads the persisted settings behind an overlay while keeping the overlay's own overrides (#12229 by @Xytronix)

Changed

  • model is now declared in every task schema: a task call, eval agent() or workpool() that passes a model the operator's configuration does not allow is refused with an error (#12229 by @Xytronix)
  • Viewing a subagent or returning to the main session no longer posts a "Viewing agent …" / "Returned to main session" status (a popup in Tern); the status line and Tern's composer already show which agent is in view
  • In a Tern pane, omp stats shows the dashboard in place of the block it runs in, with a Close button (or Esc, or Ctrl+C) that stops it and brings the terminal back, and /stats opens it in a browser block beside omp, instead of the system browser
  • bash tool commands now see PI_TOOL_CALL_ID, the id of the call running them, so a script the agent runs can point at that call in the session transcript (#17489 by @will-bogusz)
  • Native judgments with a configured fallback now move to it after a 3-second candidate deadline (configurable with judgment.attemptTimeoutMs) and briefly skip the timed-out route; without a configured fallback a slow judge is never cut off or replaced (#17465 by @Xytronix).

Fixed

  • Fixed a ! or $ command run while the agent works floating over the composer in Tern, where expanding its output covered the conversation; it now sits at the end of the conversation
  • Fixed out:// replies sent from an eval cell (tool.write to out://, or tool.bash with > out://) never appearing even though the write reported "Shown to the user."; they now draw as replies after the eval card, and are refused where nothing would show them (a backgrounded cell, a browser tab script)
  • Fixed a write to out:// (such as out://baselines.md) drawing as a Write card with line numbers instead of a reply streaming as prose
  • Fixed table charts drawing a ratio or speedup column as a series beside the timings it was computed from, which read as "719× less" against the baseline
  • Fixed read of a directory hiding existing dist, build, node_modules, .git, and other dependency/build/cache subdirectories, which made them look absent (#17539)
  • Fixed artifact writes reporting the staging-file cleanup error instead of the original short-write or publication failure (#17485 by @jchanghong023)
  • Fixed MCP tool calls failing without reconnecting after DNS or socket-open errors (#17461 by @Xytronix).
  • Fixed MCP connection timeouts and cancellation allowing a stdio server to start after the connection attempt had already failed. (#17512 by @jchanghong023)
  • Fixed ACP updates and extension dialogs switching to an unadvertised session handle after a session reset, and a client reopening a continued conversation after a restart landing on the original session (#17517 by @jchanghong023)
  • Fixed IRC coordination cards remaining visible when Hide Tool Activity is enabled, including live messages and replay (#17498 by @dannyboy-ai).
  • Fixed a message you queue while the agent waits on ask sitting behind the unanswered dialog; the dialog now closes without cancelling the turn, while IRC messages and background completions leave it open (#17537).
  • Fixed JS eval output() ignoring its documented offset, limit, query and format options and returning the raw read tool result; it now returns the selected text (or the format: "json" metadata) like Python's output() (#17455)
  • Fixed session lookup losing readable project sessions when an unrelated project folder is unreadable (#17467 by @Xytronix).
  • Fixed the advisor resending a byte-identical refused review before trying its model fallback when the review contained no primary reasoning to strip (#17473)
  • Fixed read of a whole URL returning no content when the page's first line is over the 50 KB output budget, as on minified pages read with :raw; it now shows that line's first 50 KB (#17500 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed an advisor whose usage-limited account kept being reported as switchable retrying the same capped account thousands of times; it now tries each sibling account at most once per provider per failing review, then falls back, waits, or pauses on the quota (#17472)
  • Fixed LSP definition, type definition, implementation and reference results carrying a stray carriage return on every source context line from files with Windows (CRLF) line endings (#17549 by @JustasMasiulis)

@oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi

Fixed

  • Fixed heuristic episodic facts storing word fragments (Drafting is active. → ctive), truncated multiword objects, or nothing for has an … sentences (#17511)

@oh-my-pi/pi-natives

Added

  • Added listWorkspace({ pruneExcludedDirs: false }) to stop pruning standard dependency/build directory names; hidden directories such as .git also require hidden: true (#17539)

@oh-my-pi/omp-stats

Added

  • Added setStatsCloseHandler: while a host sets one, the dashboard shows a Close button in its top bar and closes on Esc or Ctrl+C (with no text selected), for hosts that show it in place of their terminal

Fixed

  • Fixed tool error rates counting skipped tool calls that were explicitly marked as not executed (#17463 by @Xytronix).

@oh-my-pi/pi-tui

Added

  • Added assertModelSupportsEffortCeiling(), which throws when a model has no supported thinking effort at or below a task.maxEffort ceiling (#12229 by @Xytronix)
  • Added iconButton(), quietButton() and segmentedTabs() to native/overlay, and disabled, busy and icon options to actionButton()
  • Added nativeTail to Composer.setRuntimeChildren options: containers whose children continue the native surface's main after the transcript instead of riding in the dock
  • Added isHighlightLanguage and createCodeFrameStyler for renderers that highlight source lines in their file's language (#17550 by @JustasMasiulis)

Changed

  • Grep and read results with gaps between line runs now render in Tern as one code block that scrolls sideways as a whole, with … gap rows aligned in the line-number gutter
  • Tern builds that draw the button kind get omp's buttons as real buttons (pointer cursor, accessible pressed/disabled state, a disabled button's tooltip says why) and segmented controls as tabs variant: "segmented"; older Tern builds keep the role-styled rows
  • Source lines in Grep, AST Grep and Find results and LSP symbol names are syntax-highlighted in their file's language instead of drawn in one color; consecutive lines highlight together, so multi-line strings and comments keep their colors (#17550 by @JustasMasiulis)

Fixed

  • Fixed table charts plotting a ratio column against the timings it divides (ratio 0.997 beside C++ (ms) drew as "719× less"): analyzeTable reads a column equal to the quotient of two others as restating them, written bare or as ×
  • Fixed IRC coordination cards remaining visible when Hide Tool Activity is enabled, including incoming messages, automatic replies, relays, and workpool messages in live and replayed transcripts (#17498 by @dannyboy-ai).
  • Fixed text after a nested color losing the outer color, such as the rest of the /mcp and /ssh hints after the highlighted command (Run /mcp list to see all configured servers.) falling back to the default text color instead of staying muted (#17521 by @JustasMasiulis)
  • Fixed LSP definition, type definition and implementation results showing the raw Found 1 definition(s): text; the response now counts them (1 definition) and shows each location over its source lines, its own line marked like a grep match (#17549 by @JustasMasiulis)
  • Fixed an LSP definition, type definition or implementation location whose path starts with whitespace being dropped, with its source lines shown under the previous location
  • Fixed session tree user and assistant turns looking identical in themes whose accent and success colors match or nearly match (dark-terminal, dark-poimandres, light-poimandres): user rows are now bold, the assistant: label switches to the path color, and custom and advisor messages are muted (#17520 by @wolfiesch)

@oh-my-pi/pi-utils

Added

  • Added oklabDistance, the perceptual distance between two hex colors (#17520)

@oh-my-pi/pi-wire

Added

  • Added nums to code props (TspCodeProps): each line's number, so one block can show non-contiguous lines with … gap rows where the numbers jump.
  • Added the TSP button kind (TspButtonProps: label, icon, keycaps, default/primary/quiet/danger variants, sm/md sizes, pressed, disabled with a reason, busy) and tabs variant: "segmented".

code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent ↗ 3 releases · 3 stable
v5.1.56 Stable2026-11-01T11:41:29Z

Distrusted intermediate certificates under an allowed root are not yet blocked; tracked upstream. (#11956)

Engines started by the OmO desktop app, or by an OmO server you start yourself, no longer read SSL_CERT_FILE or SSL_CERT_DIR. If your root certificate is only in such a file, install it in your operating system's certificate store, or add it in the desktop app under Settings, Extra CA certificates. A server you start yourself also keeps honoring NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS. (#11956)

On Linux, OmO now trusts only your distribution's generated certificate bundle. A root placed directly in /etc/ssl/certs or /etc/ssl/cert.pem without running update-ca-certificates or update-ca-trust is no longer trusted; install it with that tool. If OmO cannot read your operating system's certificates, the failed request says why and what to do. (#11956)

The last sentence describes the completed rollout; its transport-error explanation is a later increment and is not enabled by this launcher-only change. (#11956)

Fixed

  • Memory git hooks no longer initialize unrelated supervisor modules before checking staged notes, preserving validation. The startup cut applies to the source runtime (tests and dev), where one pre-commit hook took about 3.7 s; the packaged plugin bundle already deferred module initialisation, and its hook-mode time was measured unchanged (about 133-151 ms before and after). (#11957) (#12037)
  • Completed-turn memory journal counters are delivered before agent_settled and agent_idle, even when the bounded maintenance observer expires. Journal delivery does not wait for full snapshots, git reads, journal writes or reflection recovery. Late full snapshots preserve newer journal accounting, and unreadable transcripts fall back to durable counters. (#11935) (#12037)
  • A foreground task spawn's running progress updates wait for launch settlement and carry the model the child actually started on (and a start-time fallback's route), instead of publishing incomplete model facts when the launch exceeds 250 ms. Foreground batch rows wait the same way and carry the launched run epoch and route (batch rows do not report effective_model). A launch that fails releases the held updates instead of freezing them; pending slot reports remain immediate (#11693, fixes #11691, #11827). (#12037)

Changed

  • Memory command tests avoid redundant hook checks while seeding trusted fixtures, while retaining real hooks for later writes. (#11954) (#12037)

Added

  • Add the engine CA importer's launcher trust stage: verify and adopt an inherited generation, or acquire a private generation and exec once with an independent hop bound. A failed import keeps only explicit extras and leaves implicit default inputs closed; child environments regain their original values. This is the launcher increment of the staged rollout, not the transport-error, background-refresh, trust CLI or desktop integration. (#11956, part of #10762)

v5.1.55 Stable2026-11-01T07:08:35Z

remove-ai-slops now names the two Bun scripts the programming skill ships for test work. Phase 2 runs check-test-junk.ts over every in-scope test file and treats its file:line findings as category-9 candidates (never automatic cuts); Phase 4b names mutation-proof.ts as the command behind the serial apply/run/restore proof it already described. (#12017)

The programming skill ships two Bun scripts that make the test rules mechanical. check-test-junk.ts flags the junk classes a regex can see in touched test files (source greps, prose pins, fixed sleeps, .only/.skip, self-comparisons, lower-bound cardinalities) with a per-line opt-out, and mutation-proof.ts breaks a production owner, runs the named tests, restores the file byte for byte and prints red/green, so "test your test" is one command. (#11972)

remove-ai-slops now prunes junk tests with the same table the programming skill and the gate reviewer use. Category 9 marks every in-scope test R/F/C/D, proves each deletion or merge by its class's rule (a production mutation for the behavior classes) before the cut, keeps the retention bar, and reports a baseline-red test as a bug instead of deleting it; behavior is locked with gate-passing tests rather than change certificates, and the report carries a Tests Ledger. (#11968)

  • senpi-task: a message sent to a daemon task while its launch is being recorded keeps its input identity; the task record no longer rolls its effect_seq back, and a record rewritten to the same size is no longer read stale (#10708). (#11946)

  • Internal telemetry maintenance. (#11882)

Fixed

  • omo remote attach on Windows now reports a stopped OmO device service as not running instead of a raw connection error (#12042). (#12043)
  • Memory sync on a CLI sign-in recovers after the OS credential store briefly reads empty (a locked keychain, a racing writer). The operations that saw the empty read are still refused, but the next sync pass gets a live account instead of staying off until restart. A real sign-out or credential change still stops sync (#11812). (#12001)
  • On Windows, omo host ensure forwards a private pipe pair through the npm launcher, Bun re-exec, and provisioned-runtime handoff. Both pipe handles travel together on their original stdio slots, and the waiting launcher closes its owned copies after spawning. Invalid or aliased pairs remain null declarations; POSIX socket forwarding is unchanged. (#11958)
  • Memory git failures that end without any output now say how the git process ended (exit code, signal and elapsed time) instead of a bare exit code. On macOS and Linux the signal tells an externally killed git apart from a silent git error; on Windows a killed child reports no signal, so there the elapsed time is the only clue. (#11945)
  • The compiled-worker relocation test no longer hangs now and then. Its fixture waited on terminate() from inside the worker's message handler, which races the worker's own exit and never settles on Bun 1.4.4. It now waits for the worker's clean exit after the ready message, and a timeout failure reports its signal. (#11941, fixes #11940)
  • The maintainer omob build now compiles the engine trust helper in its own cargo call, as the release workflows do, so a locally built desktop engine matches the released one. (#11939, part of #10762)
  • Validate retained research source bytes before replacing an extraction and preserve the original capture time when reusing those bytes. (#11936)
  • Memory /doctor no longer tells the user to "fix the cause" of parked facts batches without naming it: the facts check now reads as a plain-words to-do (run /facts retry for a transient cause such as a timeout, or the named fix such as setting memory.facts.model), followed by the cause counts per parked batch and the newest parked batch's run log path, and /facts retry reports how many batches it unparked and whether any parked again, with the cause. (#11909, part of #10897)
  • A skill MCP server's timeout (milliseconds, set on the server entry in the skill's mcp frontmatter or mcp.json) now bounds every direct MCP request: list tools/resources/prompts, call tool, read resource and get prompt. Values outside 1 to 2147483647 ms fall back to the SDK default (#11869, carried forward from #7224 by @AceRothstein71)

Changed

  • The omo-ai installer and launcher no longer rewrite the Claude Code version the engine advertised on Anthropic OAuth requests: senpi removed that request path together with the declaration the rewrite looked for (senpi#5131), so engine preparation keeps only the compile-safe css-tree data and the RPC stream guard, and an engine without the declaration no longer fails preparation with "unsupported Senpi". (#11964)
  • Simplified OpenCode agent assembly by removing redundant type assertions and an unused builtin-skill name inventory. Agent mode, override precedence, and skill selection remain unchanged. (#11870) (#11899)

Added

  • Categories and agents can set models_distribution: "round_robin" alongside models to spread new task children across their configured model chains. The default sequential policy keeps the existing order. Each child's fallback chain wraps from its selected starting model without repeating models, and continuations keep their current model. (#11905)
  • omo remote checks your OmO sign-in first and stops with one plain line when you are signed out, the keychain is locked or the credential store is unavailable (#11853). (#11864)
  • omo remote attach <device>/<session> shows a session from another device of this account in the attach TUI, observe-only for now: input is refused with "remote input not enabled yet" (#11853). (#11858)
  • omo remote status | devices | sessions | enable | disable shows this account's devices and the sessions on them through the OmO device service, as tables or --json, with a typed SDK (@oh-my-opencode/device-service-core) over the service's local API v1 underneath (#11853). (#11857)
  • Computer use (macOS): type() into a window that shows another computer or device (Screen Sharing, iPhone Mirroring) sends the keys of the current keyboard layout, since such a window receives key codes rather than typed text; every character is mapped before anything is sent, and a character no key types fails InvalidKey with nothing typed. In the background, text into a Screen Sharing window that needs Shift or Option fails BackgroundUnavailable before the first key (it takes modifiers from the physical keyboard; use foreground delivery), and el.type() never inserts into a remote window. (#11749, part of #11466)
  • Command Code is now offered during setup as a custom provider: when CMD_API_KEY (or COMMANDCODE_API_KEY) is present in the environment, setup writes a keyless models.json provider entry covering both Command Code wires (Anthropic messages and OpenAI-compatible chat completions) and stores the key reference in auth.json, so agents can use Command Code models without manual provider configuration (#11326). (#11326)

Improved

  • Simplify agent-usage reminder state reuse without changing reminder caps, delegation suppression or session cleanup. (#11890) (#11899)

v5.1.54 Stable2026-10-31T16:03:02Z

5.1.53 and 5.1.52 were not published; their changes, listed under 5.1.53 and 5.1.52 below, ship in this release.

The programming skill's Go scaffolder writes LF files on every platform. A checkout that converts line endings (Windows with autocrlf) no longer leaks CRLF into the project it generates; the templates are pinned to LF in .gitattributes and normalised on read. (#11991)

The programming skill's Python, Rust, and Go project scaffolders run on Bun, so Rust and Go users no longer install uv and typer just to start a project. bun run scripts/python/new-project.ts, scripts/python/new-script.ts, scripts/rust/new-project.ts, and scripts/go/new-project.ts replace the old uv run ... .py commands and produce the same files. A missing uv or cargo now ends with a clear message and exit code 1, and a missing go still writes a fallback go.mod. (#11970)

The programming skill routes every test file to a testing reference that carries the four-question authoring gate and the junk-test classes. Writing, reshaping, or deleting a test now loads references/testing/README.md (Given/When/Then, the mock ladder, determinism, the prompt-test rule, and a "test your test" mutation step) and references/testing/junk-classes.md (the one table of junk classes, retention bar, and R/F/C/D marks that the gate reviewer applies), so a test that would be deleted in review is a test the skill stops you from writing. (#11967)

Fixed

  • The release check for the macOS keychain helper accepts a correctly signed helper again: it ignores the /* exists */ notes codesign prints in the designated requirement, and still rejects a different identifier or team (#11980). (#11981)

Panniantong/Agent-Reach ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v1.6.1 Stable2026-11-01T07:24:15Z

中文：

  • 全网搜索、Reddit、小红书、B站在 1.6.0 里会出现的几种"明明能查却报错"或"显示成功但内容是空的"，这版都修好了。
  • 电脑上别的软件占用了浏览器端口时，可以换一个端口，不用关掉那个软件。
  • 复制登录失败时会如实告诉你，不再假装成功。
  • Windows 上小红书带特殊符号的链接能正常打开了。

English:

  • Several 1.6.0 cases where web search, Reddit, Xiaohongshu or Bilibili failed although the content was reachable, or reported success with empty content, are fixed.
  • When another program on your computer uses the browser port, Agent Reach can use a different one; you don't have to close that program.
  • A login copy that fails now says so instead of reporting success.
  • On Windows, Xiaohongshu links with special characters open correctly.

中文（技术细节）：

  • 全网搜索：请求统一带上 agent-reach/<版本号> 标识，避免被 Exa 的防护拦截（#877）。
  • Reddit：站内工具临时失败（比如返回网页而不是数据）时，自动改用公开网页搜索和阅读（#880）。
  • 小红书：适配 OpenCLI 2.0 的返回格式，阅读不再"成功但内容全空"；搜索和评论没有结果时也不再返回一条空数据（#861、#895）。
  • B站：扫码后如果没存下有效登录，不再显示登录成功；提示改为运行 agent-reach login bilibili（#866、#883）。
  • 专用浏览器端口可以改：agent-reach configure browser-port <端口>，9222 被别的软件占用时用（#848）。
  • 复制登录：浏览器后台程序没开时不再记一次"复制了 0 条"；手动 login <渠道> --import-existing 一条都没复制到时会明确报错（#879）。
  • Windows：链接里带 & 的小红书笔记能正常阅读和查看评论（#860）。

English (technical):

  • Web search: every request identifies itself as agent-reach/<version>, so Exa's Cloudflare front no longer blocks it (#877).
  • Reddit: when the site tool fails transiently (for example it returns HTML instead of data), search and read fall back to the public web (#880).
  • Xiaohongshu: OpenCLI 2.0 results are mapped, so read no longer succeeds with empty fields; search and comments no longer return one empty row when there are no results (#861, #895).
  • Bilibili: a QR login that saved no usable credential is no longer reported as success, and the hint now says agent-reach login bilibili (#866, #883).
  • The dedicated browser's port is configurable with agent-reach configure browser-port <port>, for when another tool holds 9222 (#848).
  • Login reuse: no "copied 0 cookies" record when the browser bridge is down; an explicit login <channel> --import-existing that copies nothing now fails clearly (#879).
  • Windows: Xiaohongshu note links containing & can be read and their comments loaded (#860).

HyperFrames v0.8.226

Released on 2026-11-01.

Safari keeps edited films' audio playing, and renders can pass a lone full-frame video straight through when you opt in. Apps that host Studio can show their own preview loader.

Features

  • Producer: Opt-in video layer passthrough for a lone full-canvas video (98520366a, #6914).
  • Studio: A host that draws its own loader can turn off both of Studio's preview loaders (a7075fcb6, #6911).
  • Core: WebKit plays bare audio from a decoded buffer on the audio clock (e181d34ed, #6912).
  • Core: The playback health reading says which clock the film followed (bba3676a3, #6906).

Fixes

  • Core: Safari keeps playing edits' audio without seeks or rate changes (2c1a10f3a, #6888).
  • CLI: Snapshot gives a seek that will not settle its own --timeout, not three minutes (52a42983d, #6910).
  • Engine: Ffprobe read intervals never carry an exponent (f486ad6d4, #6909).
  • Producer: A failed video extraction names which clip files failed (32de0196d, #6905).
  • CLI: Billing and Desktop handoff read their hosts from settings (5ce6b30bd, #6897).
  • Engine: Scale static-frame verification budget with the job (f3cdf2b47, #6901).
  • CLI: Measure ink, one output-folder flag spelling, logo wordmark variant (8a0b8a9c2, #6891).
  • Producer: Render telemetry reports beyond-viewport capture as the workers used it (bb3c3b211, #6702).
  • CLI: One cut detector that tells real cuts from flashes and fast moves (525909726, #6894).
  • CLI: Cloud render uses the composition's data-fps and skips unused heavy files (ee50cd2fc, #6895).
  • Core: A page saved as UTF-16 bundles as its text, not NUL bytes (88f9ae846, #6580).

Internal

  • Engine: One builder for the video frame filter chain (94849bf1e, #6908).
  • Split the cli test job into two shards so each stays well under its limit (a2c5a8a02, #6902).
  • Engine: Run the non-PNG probe test on a fake clock (ef0007b00, #6907).

Install

Windows

Zip

  1. Download nvim-win64.zip (or nvim-win-arm64.zip for ARM)
  2. Extract the zip
  3. Run nvim.exe in your terminal

MSI

  1. Download nvim-win64.msi (or nvim-win-arm64.msi for ARM)
  2. Run the MSI
  3. Run nvim.exe in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to install vcruntime*.dll.

macOS (x86_64)

  1. Download nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz
  2. Run xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
  3. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz
  4. Run ./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim

macOS (arm64)

  1. Download nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz
  2. Run xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
  3. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz
  4. Run ./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim

Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) builds for older glibc.

AppImage

  1. Download nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage
  2. Run chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage
    • If your system does not have FUSE you can extract the appimage:
      ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim

Tarball

  1. Download nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
  2. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
  3. Run ./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim

Linux (arm64)

AppImage

  1. Download nvim-linux-arm64.appimage
  2. Run chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage
    • If your system does not have FUSE you can extract the appimage:
      ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim

Tarball

  1. Download nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz
  2. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz
  3. Run ./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim

studio-v2.56.1Reasonix Studio v2.56.1 Stable2026-11-01T02:52:12Z

本版是修复版：收紧只读命令判定中 python -v 的漏洞，限制模型同时打开的网页数量，并修复手机窄屏布局、定时运行按钮空白、待发送区误显示按钮、中文路径导致会话读不出等问题。

变更

  • 工作区在网络盘（如 SMB 映射盘）上时，运行无法判断写入范围的命令前的目录遍历改为并发读取，大目录树上等待大幅缩短。关联 #14813。
  • 启动环境摘要优先复用当前数据目录的可信快照，避免其他目录的探测结果改变系统提示、降低首次请求的缓存命中率。修复 #14676 by @SivanCola。

修复

  • 安全：只读命令判定现在只把 node 和 python 单独的版本探针（如 python3 -V）当作只读；python3 -v 脚本 这类会运行代码的调用需要批准。关联 #14886。
  • 模型同时打开的网页上限为 12 个，超过时会提示它先关闭用完的页面，避免一次搜索开出几十个页面占用数 GB 内存；你自己打开的页面不受限。修复 #14844 fixed in #14866。
  • 手机窄屏：侧栏菜单按钮不再紧贴标志；设置页「关闭」与放大按钮并排，设置标签按内容宽度排列。修复 #14865 fixed in #14873、#14867 fixed in #14873、#14868 fixed in #14873。
  • 「自动化 → 定时运行」的「预览」和「确认创建」按钮不再显示为空白。修复 #14870 fixed in #14871。
  • 待发送区里已被当前轮接收的插话只显示「立即发送」与「取回」，不再出现点了就报"当前状态不允许此操作"的「改」和移动按钮。修复 #14875 fixed in #14877。
  • 会话的分支信息含中文路径时，不再因编码误判丢掉反斜杠、导致整个会话读不出来。关联 #14841 by @ShryukGrandhi。
  • 内置浏览器拾取元素时，属性名按属性值同样的上限裁剪。关联 #14580、#14849 by @jf200s。
  • /migrate 读不到旧会话目录时会报出目录和原因，不再说没有需要迁移的会话。关联 #14823 by @chuiwenwei。
  • doctor repair 读不到配置时报告 unreadable 并以非零退出，--apply 不再改写它；doctor runtime 没有可询问的 runtime 时显示 unknown。关联 #14824 by @chuiwenwei、#14825 by @chuiwenwei。
  • 完成报告、步骤提示和能力诊断里截断的中文等多字节文字不再出现半个字符。关联 #14842 by @kevin9327、#14843 by @kevin9327、#14851 by @kevin9327。

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@SivanCola、@ShryukGrandhi、@jf200s、@chuiwenwei、@kevin9327

<!-- lang:en -->

Changed

  • With the workspace on a network drive such as an SMB share, the walk before an unclassified command reads concurrently, much faster on big trees. Refs #14813.
  • Startup summaries prefer the current data home's trusted snapshot, so another directory's probe no longer changes the system prompt and cold-starts the cache. Fixes #14676 by @SivanCola.

Fixed

  • Security: the read-only check treats only a bare node or python version probe (such as python3 -V) as a read; python3 -v script and other calls that run code need approval. Refs #14886.
  • The model can have at most 12 pages open; past that it is asked to close finished ones, so one search no longer opens dozens. Your own pages are not limited. Fixes #14844 fixed in #14866.
  • On a phone, the sidebar menu button no longer touches the logo, Settings puts Close beside expand, and its tabs fit their content. Fixes #14865 fixed in #14873, #14867 fixed in #14873, #14868 fixed in #14873.
  • The "Preview" and "Confirm" buttons of Automation → Scheduled runs no longer show blank. Fixes #14870 fixed in #14871.
  • Guidance the running turn already accepted shows only send-now and withdraw in the pending panel, not the edit and move buttons that always failed. Fixes #14875 fixed in #14877.
  • A branch record holding a CJK path no longer loses a backslash to a wrong charset guess, which made the whole session unreadable. Refs #14841 by @ShryukGrandhi.
  • When the built-in browser picks an element, attribute names are clipped to the same limit as values. Refs #14580, #14849 by @jf200s.
  • /migrate names the directory and the cause when it cannot read the legacy sessions, instead of saying there was nothing to migrate. Refs #14823 by @chuiwenwei.
  • doctor repair reports an unreadable config and exits non-zero, --apply leaves it alone; doctor runtime says unknown with no runtime to ask. Refs #14824 by @chuiwenwei, #14825 by @chuiwenwei.
  • Multi-byte text cut in completion reports, step hints and capability diagnostics no longer ends in half a character. Refs #14842 by @kevin9327, #14843 by @kevin9327, #14851 by @kevin9327.

Contributors

Thanks to this release's contributors: @SivanCola, @ShryukGrandhi, @jf200s, @chuiwenwei, @kevin9327

What's Changed

  • fix(ci): set up pnpm before the Node cache that needs it in the Android workflow by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14811
  • fix(ci): run the Android scripts through bash and build the kernel at the tag's version by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14812
  • fix(ci): the Android page check writes its token file owner-only by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14814
  • perf(agent): read the criteria walk's directories and files concurrently by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14813
  • ci(android): let the workflow build a branch as a trial run that publishes nothing by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14817
  • fix(android): verify the two POMs the Gradle classpath needs on CI, and store the file with LF by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14819
  • fix(android): verify the Linux aapt2 jar the CI build resolves by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14820
  • fix(boot): preserve environment snapshot precedence / 保持环境探测快照前缀稳定 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14676
  • fix(android): verify the 24 artifacts the release lint task resolves on CI by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14821
  • fix(doctor): a runtime nobody can ask is not clean by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14825
  • fix(sessionstore): decode the branch-meta sidecar as UTF-8 before transcoding by @ShryukGrandhi in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14841

macOS 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。Windows 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。Linux Debian 系从 .deb 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 .rpm 安装（sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。也提供 .AppImage（只提供下载，不会自更新；需要 FUSE 2，或用 --appimage-extract-and-run 启动）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 .deb 走自己的包（.rpm 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

Graphify-Labs/graphify ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.9.100graphify 0.9.100 Stable2026-11-01T00:53:21Z

0.9.100 (2026-11-01)

  • Fix: ids a type and a function whose names differ only in case (Foo the class, foo the function) get distinct node ids instead of colliding (which dropped one node and minted a bogus self-loop) (#4904, #4908, thanks @bercedev).
  • Fix: php a Scope::MEMBER access in a class-level initializer (a const value, a property default, or a parameter/promoted-constructor default) emits a references_constant edge; self::/static::/parent:: are skipped and unknown scopes mint no stub (#4648, #4895, thanks @Jitendarmahara).
  • Fix: hooks git rev-parse output is decoded as UTF-8, so a linked worktree under a non-ASCII path resolves correctly on Windows instead of mojibake (#4903, thanks @LukeTheoJohnson).
  • Fix: analyze on a code-only graph the isolated-node question reason says "possible missing edges" rather than referencing documentation gaps that cannot apply (#4887, thanks @oleksii-tumanov).
  • Perf: resolve reference edges are indexed by source once, so JS/TS import resolution no longer re-walks every edge per import (output unchanged) (#4909, #4913, thanks @Deepjyoti-Sarmah).
  • Docs: skill the skill now says when a graph is worth building, across all generated hosts, while preserving the "if the user invoked /graphify, do it as asked" invariant (#4829, #4906, thanks @TanmayShah29).
  • Fix: deps the video extra caps PyAV below 19 (av>=11,<19), because PyAV 19 removed the metadata_errors argument that faster-whisper passes unconditionally when opening audio; without the cap a fresh install on Python 3.12+ failed to transcribe (#4842, thanks @SyedFahad7).
  • Fix: r setClass/setRefClass S4/R5 inheritance declared with contains= now emits an inherits edge (previously only R6Class's inherit= was recognised) (#4902, thanks @ayushcodes10).
  • Fix: elixir a bare function call resolves to a function in the caller's own module before other modules, instead of binding to the last-walked same-named definition (#4900, thanks @ayushcodes10).
  • Fix: dart a mixin on A, B clause resolves every superclass constraint, not just the first (#4899, thanks @ayushcodes10).
  • Fix: fortran a derived type's extends(base) emits an inherits edge, bringing Fortran in line with the other OOP extractors (#4897, thanks @ayushcodes10).
  • Fix: scala an extension (x: T) def m is scoped to its receiver type T (a method edge to T) instead of leaking to file scope (#2044, #4856, thanks @divakantpandey).
  • Fix: terraform a node carries its original scope so ids stay stable when a cached project directory is moved, instead of re-deriving the scope from the new path (#4858, #4861, thanks @yUm1k4).
  • Fix: extract (JVM) Java and Kotlin imports, extends/implements and member calls resolve across files and across the two languages when a written FQN names exactly one sourced type (#4874, #4879, thanks @Deepjyoti-Sarmah).
  • Fix: export a path/explain/wiki rendering lists every parallel relation between two nodes (via edge_datas), and a raw --no-cluster write marks the graph multigraph so parallel edges survive reload (#4794, thanks @ensell-yes).
  • Fix: export a partial or failed backup is reported as no backup and retried on the next run, instead of being recorded as a false success (#3769, #4834, thanks @barlowa124).
  • Fix: affected graphify affected (and query --seed) resolve the same path::Symbol and dotted reference forms explain accepts, reusing explain's resolver, and exit non-zero (3 ambiguous / 4 not-found) on a seed that does not resolve (#4792, #4797, thanks @dupeisen).
  • Fix: install graphify uninstall removes every platform's user-scope skill (13 were left behind) and the kilo global command; and graphify kilo uninstall removes the kilo skill's references/ sidecar (#4782, #4789, thanks @bercedev).
  • Feat: llm the Claude backend caches its (stable, large) system prompt with cache_control, counting the cached tokens back into input_tokens, and GRAPHIFY_CLAUDE_PROMPT_CACHE=0 disables it for gateways that reject cache_control (#4835, #4855, #4880, thanks @Jvxoq and @1akashkalita).
  • Fix: prompt the node-id format description in the extraction prompt matches what ids.py actually produces (word characters kept, non-ASCII letters/digits preserved, ASCII lowercased) instead of the stale "[a-z0-9_] only" wording (#4432, #4799, thanks @dupeisen).
  • Docs: how-it-works the supported-language count is updated (about 40: 33 tree-sitter grammars plus 7 built-in parsers) and Pass 3 is described as running the configured LLM backend, not Claude only (#4873, thanks @SyedFahad7).

sinelaw/fresh ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.5.7fresh-editor 0.5.7 Stable2026-10-31T18:52:04Z

0.5.7

For live updates on Fresh, follow me on X.

Most config options below can be changed in the Settings UI - run Open Settings from the command palette (Ctrl+P).

Features

  • Compare Files - fresh --diff A B shows any two files side by side, both editable (#3611, requested by @cherio)
  • Universal Search across all workspaces - toggle All workspaces (Alt+A) to search every local workspace's files, unsaved buffers and terminals; Enter jumps there (#3654)
  • fresh --update - alias for fresh --cmd update, which now asks before installing instead of looking like a finished update (#3064, #3614, reported by @davidwooff)
  • Shift+Home selects to the first non-blank character first, then column 0, like Home - new select_smart_home action (#3585, #3669, requested by @notnout)
  • Nix installation noted on the homepage (#3635, by @dwt)

Bug Fixes

  • Idle CPU, memory and log growth from git_statusbar on Linux - file reads no longer count as changes, which re-ran git several times a second (#3607, #3659, reported by @naoto-anzai)
  • Search & Replace honours Case Sensitive and Whole Word (#3575, #3640, reported by @Korkman)
  • Unsaved work is kept in one place whatever the launch mode - one buffer per file, saves refuse to overwrite a file another Fresh has open, sudo saves are crash-safe, and switching workspaces keeps your tab in front (#3633, #3639, #3660)
  • Hot exit entries are replaced atomically by a save (#3626, #3627)
  • Undo restores the exact bytes of a deleted non-UTF-8 byte instead of writing U+FFFD on save (#3652, #3655)
  • Sudo-saving a new file no longer creates it with mode 000 (#3641, #3653, reported by @ViolinKaine)
  • Files over SSH are writable when the remote user owns them, even if local and remote UIDs differ (#2944, #3669, reported by @mommysgoodpuppy)
  • Ctrl+V in a terminal pane reaches the program when the clipboard has no text, so agent CLIs can paste images; turn off with terminal.pass_ctrl_v_without_text (#3129, #3658, reported by @andreivinca)
  • Typing in long wrapped lines is one frame per key and no longer stutters (#3631, #3632, reported by @jmote)
  • Home, End, Up and Down after fast typing land in the right place (#3642, #3656)
  • Replace-all on huge files uses far less memory (#3642, #3657)
  • Orchestrator picker returns the keyboard to the dock only if it had it, so arrow keys no longer reach a terminal shell (#3136, #3661)
  • Terminal fixes
    • macOS clipboard errors no longer paint over the screen (#3662, #3664, reported by @mruff-aeq)
    • kitty keyboard protocol is enabled for clients attached to the daemon, so Super shortcuts work (#3618, #3640, reported by @S-AM-I)
  • Exported Bash functions survive environment capture (#3586, #3640, reported by @warrenfalk)
  • A workspace file that exists but can't be opened keeps its place in the layout (#3532, #3640)
  • Ctrl+P list fits on short terminals instead of covering the input line (#3578, #3669)
  • View menu Line Numbers / Line Wrap show the real setting on terminal and Welcome tabs and are greyed out there (#3550, #3669, reported by @sjsepan3)
  • Status bar shows "Bash" instead of "Bourne Again Shell (bash)" (#2727, #3669, reported by @720720)
  • Palette hint bar colors follow the selected-row foreground, so themes are easier to style (#3616, #3653, reported by @Korkman)
  • Search & replace polish - Unicode word highlights, replace within a multi-line selection, cheaper recovery for large replace-alls, accurate Live Grep over terminals (#3645, #3648)
  • Markdown Source/Compose scroll sync no longer drifts or stalls (#3609)
  • Plugin panels recolor when rewritten to text of the same length (#3646, #3647)
  • Macros with plugin-bound keys replay once and in order, without timer ticks (#3595, #3597)
  • fresh --diff opens without an empty-editor flash and scrolls smoothly (#3630)
  • Docs - tabs vs spaces, auto_revert_poll_interval_ms, and the rendering architecture are corrected (#3114, #3272, #3599, #3669, #3653; #3114 reported by @sgon00)

Internals

  • Plugin API - runOnTarget / a machine's run replaces the deprecated spawnProcess; plugin calls can target another workspace; plugin commands from a hook apply as one batch (#3637, #3654)
  • Debian packaging, CI sharding and advisory fixes, dependency bumps, flaky-test fixes (#3593, #3596, #3604, #3605, #3606, #3629, #3650, #3651)

farion1231/cc-switch ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v4.0.23CC Switch v4.0.23 Stable2026-10-31T16:37:31Z

CC Switch v4.0.23

本版本让 Kimi Code、MiniMax Code、Oh My Pi 的供应商编辑器按应用自己的格式显示配置文件里这一家的部分；Claude Code、Claude Desktop 经路由连 OpenAI 格式和 Gemini 的上游时，客户端选的思考档位能发给更多模型，卡片上还可以选怎么发；授权中心可以一键刷新所有账号的额度；Antigravity、MiniMax Code 的用量记录有了耗时和首字时间。另外修复了 Windows 上进入轻量模式后主窗口回不来、经路由连部分 OpenAI 格式的上游时切换模型失败、DeepSeek Harness 的配置目录是链接时无法编辑供应商、Grok Build 超过 50 MiB 的会话用量不统计、Codex 分支会话用量一直不导入、DeepSeek Harness 等应用测试官方余额时提示 Key 为空、供应商表单里几个编辑器互相覆盖等问题。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 v4.0 发布说明。

English → | 日本語版 →

新增

Kimi Code、MiniMax Code、Oh My Pi 的供应商编辑器按原生格式显示

以前这三个应用的供应商编辑器显示的是卡片的 JSON，和它们实际的配置文件对不上，上游文档里的配置片段也贴不进来。现在编辑器只显示配置文件里这一家的部分，位置和格式都和文件一致：

  • Kimi Code：config.toml 里的 [providers.<key>] 和它的 [models."..."] 表。
  • MiniMax Code：YAML 里的 custom_provider.<key>。
  • Oh My Pi：models.yml 里的 providers.<key>。

标题显示实际的文件路径，会跟着目录覆盖和 KIMI_CODE_HOME 这类变量变化。草稿有格式错误、写了别家的节点、或者写了 default_model 这类全局设置时会提示并拒绝保存，改好之前上方的表单字段暂时不能改，避免把草稿覆盖掉。在编辑器里写的注释不会保存。DeepSeek Harness 的供应商在 profile 补丁里，仍用 JSON 编辑器。

经路由连 Gemini 时，思考档位也能发过去

以前 Claude Code、Claude Desktop 经路由转成 Gemini 原生格式时，客户端选的思考档位和「关闭思考」都被丢掉，Gemini 一律用模型的默认设置。现在按 Gemini 自己的 OpenAI 兼容接口的换算方式发：

  • Gemini 2.5：低、中、高分别是 1024、8192、24576 的思考预算。关闭思考时 Flash 和 Flash-Lite 发 0，Pro 不能关，发最小的 128。
  • Gemini 3 及以后：发 low、medium、high 档位（Gemini 3 Pro 没有 medium，发 high）。这些模型都不能关闭思考，关闭时发支持的最低档。
  • 认不出的模型、图片和语音这类模型、名字里已经带档位的中转别名（如 gemini-3-pro-high）不发，请求里本来没有思考设置时也不发。

授权中心「全部刷新」

授权中心页头多了「全部刷新」按钮，一次重新查询页面上所有账号的额度（DeepSeek 是余额），各行照常显示更新中（#9073）。

改进

Claude Code、Claude Desktop 经路由连 OpenAI 格式的上游时，思考档位能发给更多模型（#9062）。以前只有 o 系列、GPT-5 以上和 Grok 4.5 以上会收到思考档位，DeepSeek 等其他模型静默丢掉，日志里也没有记录。现在：

  • 认得出的供应商按它支持的档位发，比如 DeepSeek 发 low、high、max，OpenRouter 最高到 xhigh；Kimi、GLM、Qwen、MiniMax 这类 OpenAI 接口不收这个参数的不发。
  • 认不出的上游只发 low、medium、high，选 xhigh、max 时发 high。
  • GPT-3.5、GPT-4、Llama、Mistral 不发；关掉思考时不发。
  • 两个应用的供应商表单在这两种格式下多了「思考档位」：「自动（推荐）」按上面的规则发；「原样发送」客户端选哪档发哪档，上游不支持 xhigh 或 max 时会报错；「不发送」用于上游因这个参数报错的情况。托管账号的卡片不显示这一项。

Codex 经路由连 DeepSeek 时的档位换算也改成和 DeepSeek 官方一致：minimal、low 发 low，medium、high、xhigh 发 high，max 发 max。以前 low 会被提到 high，xhigh 会被提到 max。

Antigravity、MiniMax Code 的用量记录有了耗时和首字时间。 以前这两个应用的用量里没有速度和首字时间。以前导入的记录也会补上。

Skills 的发现页和已安装页改成同一种行样式（#9081）。仓库名用小号等宽字放在名称旁边，不再显示目录路径；「打开文档」按钮移到最右边；「已安装 · N 个应用」改成「已安装 ›」。从发现页点「已安装」跳过去时，那一行会黄色闪两下再恢复。

托盘里绑了账号的 Claude 官方卡显示账号（#9071）。以前副标题都是 www.anthropic.com，有好几张官方卡时分不出来。现在有备注显示备注，没有备注显示账号（邮箱，没有邮箱时显示组织名）；账号不在这台电脑上时仍显示官网。

Claude Desktop 路由模式下，Haiku 档的模型名改成 claude-haiku-5-5（#9096）。Claude Desktop 把 claude-haiku-4-5 当成旧模型，Haiku 档选不了思考档位。上游本身是旧版 Claude Haiku 时不改。直连模式不受影响。

Grok Build 补上了 grok-4.6-build、grok-4.7-build、grok-4.7-build-fast 的价格（#9026）。

预设： 新增 OpenAI API Key 预设、13 家供应商的 Gemini CLI / Antigravity 预设（#9089），以及讯飞 Astron MaaS 按量付费的 Claude Code 预设（#9036）。

修复

  • Windows 上进入轻量模式后，再次启动 CC Switch，主窗口不出来，托盘也没反应，重启也没用（#9090）。
  • 经路由连 OpenAI 格式的上游、且上游对非流式请求也返回 SSE 时，切换模型报「Unable to validate model」（#9097、#9095）。现在非流式请求会收到完整的 JSON 响应。
  • DeepSeek Harness 的 profile 通过符号链接指向同一个文件时，编辑供应商、MCP 一律报冲突（#9101、#9100）。
  • Grok Build 的会话日志超过 50 MiB 后整个跳过，长会话的用量一直不统计（#9026、#6660）。现在逐行读取，之后只读新增的部分。
  • Codex 的分支会话在父会话闲置一段时间后一直不导入，用量统计不到（#9093、#9094）。
  • DeepSeek Harness、MiniMax Code、Kimi Code 在用量查询里测试官方余额或 Coding Plan 时提示「API key is empty」（#9108、#9107）。已保存的查询本来就正常，只是测试和自定义模板读不到供应商的 Key 和地址。
  • 供应商表单里，改了地址、Key、模型这些字段，再改下方的配置编辑器（或反过来），先改的内容有时被覆盖回去（#6777）。
  • 启动时界面要等后台的会话用量同步做完才响应（#9098、#9084）。
  • Codex 经 OpenRouter 用 DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 时，对话里有图片就报 404（#6194、#6176）。
  • Windows 上「本地环境检查」会打开 OpenCode 桌面版（#7027、#6973）。
  • macOS 上添加供应商时，图标选择页的返回按钮被红绿灯挡住（#9076、#9075）。
  • 开着本地路由时，MiniMax Code、DeepSeek Harness 表单里拉取到的模型列表两秒后就消失（#9068）。
  • MiniMax Code、DeepSeek Harness、Kimi Code 的 Key 输入框用输入法输入时字母重复（#9069）。
  • 用 mise 安装的 Claude Code，在授权中心添加 Claude 账号时报「default installation is ambiguous」。
  • ChatGPT 登录真的过期时，CC Switch 一直当成临时错误重试，不提示重新登录（#9049）。同一个 PR 还修了 Gemini 的 .env 里 export 开头的泄漏凭据清不掉。

致谢

感谢 @YUZHEthefool（编辑器互相覆盖、启动时界面不等数据库、DeepSeek V4 Flash 图片）、@BingZi-233（编辑器互相覆盖的最初修复）、@allenxu09（Skills 行样式、托盘显示 Claude 账号）、@thisTom（模型列表消失、输入法字母重复）、@1clipse（Codex 分支会话用量）、@kamanager2012（Grok Build 大会话）、@MonsterXia（非流式切换模型）、@yukitakasama（DeepSeek Harness 链接 profile）、@KFCSZYWJ（DeepSeek Harness 余额测试）、@ZeroZ-lab（全部刷新）、@QIN2DIM（图标选择页）、@teddyli18000（OpenCode 桌面版环境检查）、@syxscott（ChatGPT 登录过期、Gemini .env、土耳其语）的贡献。

感谢 @noqualia、@acelych、@AlexanderLIBH、@TeaDrink666、@CoolW2077、@Aibeto、@lbigdate、@ayingafu、@tarnish233、@yadenox 报告问题、提供复现信息和修复思路。

特别感谢以下贡献者：你们的 PR 发现并修复了真实的问题，只是同样的问题后来在主线上另行修好，PR 因此关闭。@thynomex（「打开终端」跳过权限确认）、@CupOfBread（图标选择页被红绿灯挡住）、@YUZHEthefool（Grok Build 大会话逐行读取、关于页卡死、额度重置时间、Codex 模型目录）。也感谢 @Owlbay 最早提出把图标选择页改成内容区面板（#8438）。
